response.sql: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT order_id, invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS invoice_share FROM invoice_counts), compared AS (SELECT invoice_count, invoice_share, AVG(invoice_share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(invoice_count), 0) AS total_number_of_invoices, AVG(invoice_share) AS average_share, AVG(invoice_share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE invoice_share > overall_average_share;

assumptions.assumption: If there are no invoices, shares are undefined; the query returns zero invoices and NULL for both averages.
